name: Bình minh ở Dược Cốc
scene: An intimate immortal herbal valley, viewed FROM UNDER A LOW BAMBOO EAVE. A healer kneels at LEFT foreground to gently bind a tired white crane's wing, an apprentice brings a celadon bowl from CENTER, blooming medicinal flowers and a waterfall-fed pool stretch toward RIGHT. Pale sage, soft coral, creamy gold and misty turquoise. Compassion and relief, one small alchemy hut tucked among giant roots, subtle spiritual glow, no moon.
